identity.title: Technology-independent three-heater MZI model package
identity.description: Ideal Tian SI-1 transfer, parameterized non-ideal engineering model, typed ports, and explicit evidence boundaries.

provenance.source: Tian et al. (2025), Photonic Transformer Chip: Interference Is All You Need, SI-1; EIS source transcription in EISKKA/PTCPrototype.lean
provenance.pdkIdentity: NONE — technology-independent; no foundry PDK selected

assumptions: Ideal equations use the Tian SI-1 phase and normalization convention.
Non-ideal model uses a simplified two-coupler visibility factor and scalar propagation loss.
Heater phase response is linear in thermally coupled electrical power in this first-order model.
Thermal dynamics are represented by three first-order states.
Test fixture parameters are synthetic and are not device measurements.

result.summary: Implementation package drafted; CI and local clean-environment execution are required before any pass claim.
limitations: Two-output scattering matrix and normalization/energy theorem remain an explicit model gap in v0.1.
No physical geometry, foundry layer map, DRC, LVS, EM/FDTD, fabrication, or measurement.
No device-specific heater resistance, phase efficiency, thermal matrix, or coupler characterization is asserted.
The non-ideal model is a replaceable engineering abstraction, not a validated compact model.

verification.method: Lean theorem checks plus independent Python tests; CI pending
